title: JSONSchemaBench: A Rigorous Benchmark of Structured Outputs for Language Models
reasoning: The paper presents a technical benchmark, JSONSchemaBench, specifically for evaluating the performance, efficiency, and coverage of constrained decoding frameworks for large language models. The tasks used for evaluation are technical (JSON schema compliance) or logical/mathematical (GSM8K, Last Letter, Shuffle Objects) and do not involve religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
